question: In which of the following cities was the inauguration of the Recognition of Prior Learning – Certification in Indian Sign Language Interpretation (RPL–CISLI) programme held in August 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Recognition of Prior Learning – Certification in Indian Sign Language Interpretation (RPL–CISLI)** programme was inaugurated in **New Delhi** in **August 2025**.
 
• The RPL-CISLI programme aims to provide certification to individuals proficient in **Indian Sign Language (ISL)** interpretation, enabling their skills to be formally recognized.
 
• This initiative is part of the broader framework to promote **inclusivity** and accessibility for the **hearing and speech-impaired communities** in India.
 
• The programme aligns with the government’s commitment to the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**, which emphasizes skill development and inclusiveness.
